expect.cite: Kofu SCR 138 prints "(If you can't put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, you can't use this card.)": a printed condition, kept when the effect is used through Look-Alike Show (user decision D5; official JP FAQ, Fire Energy MEE 2 / Mela: the user of the effect must meet it); with no cards in the attacker's hand Kofu can't be used, so nothing is drawn
Look-Alike Show uses the effect; the card stays in the opponent's hand (id2225, id2226)
